description: Shared correctness fixtures (docs/benchmark-correctness-fixtures.md). Three datasets (coordinate, resultWrapper, parserState), each a pair of long streams (x,y). All five variants (nonEscaping, returnedObject, storedIntoField, passedToOpaqueCall, identityObserved) construct a small two-field aggregate per element and must sum to the IDENTICAL total sum(x[i]+y[i]) for a given dataset — how the aggregate is used (locally, returned, stored, passed opaquely, identity-observed) changes whether it is scalar-replaced, never the computed result. identityObserved calls System.identityHashCode/its Rust equivalent-concept for its SIDE EFFECT only (forcing materialization) — the non-deterministic hash value itself is never included in the correctness-checked sum.

semantics.xorshift64: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 7 (unsigned/logical); x ^= x << 17 (64-bit wrapping, unsigned interpretation throughout)
semantics.coordinate: x[i] = i (linear, no RNG); y[i] = xorshift64 stream (seed=42) unsigned-mod 1000000
semantics.resultWrapper: x[i] = xorshift64 stream (seed=43) unsigned-mod 1000000; y[i] = xorshift64 stream (seed=44) unsigned-mod 1000000
semantics.parserState: x[i] = xorshift64 stream (seed=45) unsigned-mod 1000000; y[i] = xorshift64 stream (seed=46) unsigned-mod 1000000
semantics.perElementContribution: x[i] + y[i], accumulated as a wrapping 64-bit sum over all elements
